issues.message: all peer authentications are set to Unset: every matching policy is set to UNSET, so Istio falls back to the install default (permissive). Set an explicit mode (STRICT, PERMISSIVE, or DISABLE) on at least one policy if you wanted specific behavior.

duplicate at scope: two policies at the workload level — mesh-conflicts/strict-server-strict is older and is the one Istio uses. These are silently ignored: [mesh-conflicts/strict-server-duplicate]. Delete the unused ones or merge their settings into the winning policy.
